title: Meta updates terms to explicitly allow web scraping and crawlers
content:
X author: @c_ster

Meta revised its terms to allow itself and entities acting for it to use automated software including web scrapers, bots, crawlers, and user agents to access, index, cache, analyze, collect, retrieve, or crawl associated domains for its products and services.
